title: string_enum\! macro unifies all string-enum serde implementations cleanly
description: The impl_string_enum\! macro generates Serialize, Deserialize, and Display for all string-backed enums (MailboxRole, Delivered, Displayed, UndoStatus, ComparatorProperty). The pattern is consistent and correct. A contributor might suggest replacing with strum — that's fine but strum is a new dependency. The macro approach is zero-dep and correct.
